D: A thief who steals secrets from dreams is hired to plant an idea instead.
P: Serve the snacks when Ariadne folds the Paris street over their heads.
S: Paris café chocolate and ham croissants
Puff pastry crescents filled with dark chocolate, or ham and gruyere
Puff pastry cut into triangles, rolled around a stick of dark chocolate or a strip of ham and gruyère, egg washed and baked at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.
Lamb and beef meatballs with cumin and parsley, garlic yogurt to dip
Small lamb and beef meatballs with garlic, cumin and parsley, baked at 200C for 15 minutes, each speared upright on a toothpick so they look like little tops, with garlic yoghurt to dip.
the chase through the Mombasa markets

Spiced potato, peas and onion with garam masala and green chilli, folded into pastry triangles and fried until blistered, with a lime and coriander chutney. Boil 600g diced potatoes until tender. Fry an onion with 1 tsp cumin seeds, a chopped green chilli and 1 tsp grated ginger, add the potato, 100g peas and 2 tsp garam masala and mash lightly. Cut 12 spring roll wrappers in half, fold into cones, fill and seal with flour paste. Fry at 180C until crisp. Blitz a bunch of coriander, a green chilli, lime juice, salt and 2 tbsp yoghurt for chutney.
M: Glazed salmon, sushi rice, pickled ginger and rice vinegar cucumber
Salmon fillets glazed with soy, mirin and sugar and grilled until sticky, packed into boxes with sushi rice, pickled ginger, cucumber salad and a soft-boiled egg.
Snow fortress red wine beef stew
the mountain fortress on the third dream level

Beef chuck browned and braised with onion, carrot, garlic, red wine, thyme and bay until it falls apart, served over buttery mash with gremolata. Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions, 2 carrots and 4 garlic cloves, stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, then 300ml red wine and 500ml beef stock with thyme and 2 bay leaves. Return the beef, cover and simmer for 3 hours. Mash 1kg boiled potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Chop parsley with lemon zest and garlic for gremolata and scatter over the stew.
W: Dream within a dream layer cake
Three thin sponges layered with chocolate mousse and coffee cream
Three thin vanilla sponges baked at 175C for 15 minutes, layered with chocolate mousse and coffee cream, chilled 4 hours and cut to show every level.
K: Espresso, vodka and coffee liqueur shaken until frothy, three beans on top
Fresh espresso shaken hard with vodka, coffee liqueur and ice, strained into chilled glasses with three beans on top.

steps.text: Cut the pastry into long triangles.
Lay a stick of chocolate, or ham and gruyere, at the wide end and roll up towards the point.
Curve into crescents and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Mix the mince with crushed garlic, cumin, parsley and salt.
Roll into small balls.
Bake at 200C.
Mix the yoghurt with crushed garlic.
Spear each meatball upright on a toothpick and serve with the yoghurt.
Simmer the soy, mirin and sugar until syrupy.
Cook the sushi rice.
Grill the salmon, brushing with the glaze until sticky.
Soft boil the eggs, peel and halve.
Slice the cucumber thinly and dress in rice vinegar.
Pack boxes with rice, salmon, pickled ginger, cucumber and egg.

dishes.n: Dream within a dream layer cake
dishes.make_ahead: Make the day before, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with the sugar until thick and fold in the flour.
Bake 3 thin sponges at 175C and cool.
Make a chocolate mousse with melted chocolate and whipped cream.
Make a coffee cream with whipped cream and cold espresso.
Layer the sponges with mousse and coffee cream.
Chill for 4 hours.
Slice to show every level.
Brew the espresso and let it cool slightly.
Shake the espresso, vodka and coffee liqueur very hard with ice until frothy, in batches.
Strain into chilled glasses.
Float three coffee beans on the foam of each.

s.n: Paris café chocolate and ham croissants
s.note: Puff pastry crescents filled with dark chocolate, or ham and gruyere
s.how: Cut 2 puff pastry sheets into long triangles. Lay a stick of dark chocolate or a strip of ham and gruyere at the wide end and roll up towards the point. Curve into crescents, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.

s.note: Lamb and beef meatballs with cumin and parsley, garlic yogurt to dip
s.how: Mix 250g lamb mince and 250g beef mince with crushed garlic, a teaspoon of cumin, chopped parsley and salt. Roll into small balls and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Spear each upright on a toothpick like a little top and serve with yoghurt mixed with garlic.

m.note: Glazed salmon, sushi rice, pickled ginger and rice vinegar cucumber
m.how: Simmer soy sauce, mirin and a little sugar until syrupy. Grill 4 salmon fillets, brushing with the glaze until sticky. Cook 2 cups sushi rice. Pack boxes with rice, salmon, pickled ginger, thinly sliced cucumber dressed in rice vinegar, and a halved soft-boiled egg.

w.n: Dream within a dream layer cake
w.note: Three thin sponges layered with chocolate mousse and coffee cream
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick, fold in 150g self-raising flour and bake 3 thin sponges at 175C for 15 minutes. Make a chocolate mousse with melted dark chocolate and whipped cream, and a coffee cream with cream and cold espresso. Layer, chill for 4 hours and slice to show every level.

d.note: Espresso, vodka and coffee liqueur shaken until frothy, three beans on top
d.how: Brew strong espresso and let it cool slightly. For each drink, shake 30ml espresso, 45ml vodka and 15ml coffee liqueur very hard with ice until frothy. Strain into a chilled glass and float three coffee beans on the foam. Serve straight away.
